title: Three tests that held only when the machine was quiet or the store was files, made to hold on both
request: The owner: run the full gate and fix what it finds.
spec: check-all runs the suite on files and again on PostgreSQL; a test must hold on both.
plan: Read each failure and which pass it came from
Fix the test where it reads another store than it writes

decisions.decision: Fix the tests, not the product
decisions.why: in both cases the product reads and writes one store consistently; the tests wrote with one assumption and read with another

change: tests/test_memory_writing.py (the app's own workspace id), tests/test_orchestra_walk.py (the service reads the walk's own checkpoint store). tests/test_chat_agents.py (the team walk test follows a still-working reply).

findings.defect: The memory API tests wrote workspace know-how under the id local
findings.scenario: The suite's PostgreSQL pass: a reviewer's accept saw no draft and a retire answered 404 instead of 403.
findings.cause: The memory chain reads workspace items under the store's workspace id, which is local for the file store and the database's id on PostgreSQL; the tests hard-coded local.
findings.fix: The tests write under the app's own workspace id.
findings.test: tests/test_memory_writing.py ApiTest, on files and with --pg

findings.defect: A walk test saved its pause in SQLite and looked for it in PostgreSQL
findings.scenario: The suite's PostgreSQL pass: service.view found no pause waiting, so the card's key was None.
findings.cause: The test opens its walk's checkpoints with database_url empty (SQLite in its home), while service.view and resume_value follow DCLAB_DATABASE_URL.
findings.fix: For that test the service calls run with DCLAB_DATABASE_URL empty, so they read the walk's own store.

findings.defect: The team walk over MCP test failed when the walk outlasted the 100 s wait
findings.scenario: The suite's PostgreSQL pass beside a second gate: starting the walk answered 202, still working, and the test expected a pause at once.
findings.cause: As with the intern test fixed earlier tonight, the test took only the quick answer; the reply names GET /api/projects/{id}/team to follow.
findings.fix: On a still-working reply the test follows the walk's board until the pause appears.
findings.test: tests/test_chat_agents.py test_a_team_walk_started_over_mcp_pauses_and_resumes_on_the_persons_answer, also with the wait cut to 2 s

outcome: The three tests hold on the file store and on PostgreSQL, quick or slow.
lessons: A test that opens one store explicitly and then calls code that chooses its store from the environment tests two stores at once.
